name: Ship
why: A Code Project idea, from a ready repo to a merged pull request
ideal: A fresh thread finds the repo ready, opens a draft pull request, a separate reviewer reads it at its head commit, and tokens fall.

sources.title: Claude Code: cloud sessions and auto-fix
GitHub Docs: Merge a pull request
Git Crafter: tracking issues and cards

steps.name: Ready
steps.rule: A fresh thread finds the shared rules, their import, templates, CI and settings in place.

steps.name: Track
steps.rule: Each piece of work is an issue or a card, searched for first, and its pull request names it and is merged, not closed.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: A thread builds on its own claude/ branch, and a thread idle past the one hour cache is replaced, not revived.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: The thread opens its pull request as a draft and watches CI with auto-fix, so a person reads it after the checks.

steps.name: Review
tools: A reviewer that did not write the change
steps.rule: A separate reviewer, which has not seen how the code was written, reads the pull request at its head commit.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: A green, reviewed pull request squash merges, and each merged one costs fewer tokens.
